title: A planted test covers each clause of an item's goal
goal: kb-item's planted-failure step asks for one planted case per clause of the goal, so a clause cannot go unmet while the item's tests pass. Answers the reviews of SP-xdzgepun and SP-42bn4vz7, which found unmet clauses in BG-53f6xe32, BG-a3ubazze, BG-6a7jiylf, ST-q4sgzlz6, TK-zcji275w and ST-gpodng3o.
